name: Strip HTML tags - custom text format filter
description: Text filter for stripping specific HTML tags from text output
project_description:
A single text-format @Filter plugin (id 'strippfilter', 'Strip paragraph tags') that unwraps HTML paragraph tags: it keeps the inner content of every

element and discards the

wrapper (and its attributes), so an HTML/CKEditor 5 format can produce inline output with no paragraph breaks. The main use case is fields (titles, captions, credits) that should be edited in CKEditor 5 but rendered on one line, working around CKEditor 5's insistence on wrapping content in paragraph tags. Implemented with Drupal's DOM-based Html::load()/Html::serialize() (the HTML5-PHP support added in Drupal 10.2) rather than str_replace/regex, precisely because CKEditor 5 leaves stray dir/title attributes on pasted paragraph tags that a naive string replace would miss. Note: if the input contains any

element, only content inside

elements is returned (content outside paragraphs is dropped); text with no

is returned unchanged. Depends only on core filter. No settings form, no config, no routes, no permissions.
